BatchDetailOut.description: One cook batch: the recipe at the batch's practical quantities (what you measure).
BatchDetailOut.title: BatchDetailOut

CostsOut.description: cash + from_inventory = eaten + frozen_portions + leftover (staples aren't counted).
CostsOut.title: CostsOut

DayOverride.description: One day's choices for this plan only (Q8: weekly defaults + per-day values at planning time).
DayOverride.title: DayOverride

DietReviewOut.description: A possibly-beef item: held (left out of plans) until you allow it, with why it's held.
DietReviewOut.title: DietReviewOut

FrequencyCapSetting.description: A general cap: meals per week containing one ingredient (slug) or any ingredient with a tag.
FrequencyCapSetting.title: FrequencyCapSetting

GroceryGroupOut.description:
kind: store | category | all, or a section: stock_up (long-life items, outside a shop budget),
inventory (covered by what you have), staple ("check you have"), unpriced.
GroceryGroupOut.title: GroceryGroupOut

GroceryItemPatch.description: Send only what changed; a field sent as null clears it. Replaying the same patch changes nothing.
GroceryItemPatch.title: GroceryItemPatch

quantity.description: counted quantity in the lot's base unit
quantity.title: Quantity

text.description: e.g. 2 lb chicken thighs and half a cabbage
text.title: Text

ParsedLotOut.description:
One previewed item. Only `ok` and `needs_confirmation` items (with an amount) can be saved, after you
confirm them; `excluded` ones never can.
ParsedLotOut.title: ParsedLotOut

PlanRequest.description:
POST /api/v1/plans. Everything except week_start defaults to your saved settings, except the mode and
its money limit, which belong to this request only.

mode=inventory: cook from what you have; nothing is bought unless you allow topup_cents for missing
items. mode=shop: inventory first, then a grocery list; budget_cents is an optional hard limit on the
cash spent this trip (without it the cost is still minimized and reported).

budget_cents.description: shop mode: max cash this trip
budget_cents.title: Budget Cents

slot_kcal.description: Per-plan slot allocations; 0 removes a slot, a new slot adds one
slot_kcal.title: Slot Kcal

PlanRequest.title: PlanRequest

PlanStreamEvent.description:
One line of POST /api/v1/plans (application/x-ndjson). The request plans the week before it ends:
`started` (the run id), then `progress` lines and a `heartbeat` every few seconds while it works (they
keep the connection alive: iOS Safari drops a request that stays silent for about a minute), then one
`result` with the finished plan or the problem.
PlanStreamEvent.title: PlanStreamEvent

PlanSummaryOut.description: PRD §25: the weekly planning screen's data.
PlanSummaryOut.title: PlanSummaryOut

PlanningMode.description: Per-request: cook from what you have (purchases off unless you allow a top-up), or plan a shop.
PlanningMode.title: PlanningMode

PortionRequest.description: 'Make 7 portions', 'I need lunch for Monday-Friday', 'make 10 and freeze half'.
PortionRequest.title: PortionRequest

client_ref.description: set by the app; an entry replayed from the offline queue is stored once
client_ref.title: Client Ref

per_amount.description: the quantity the price covers, e.g. 1 (lb) or 20 (count)
per_amount.title: Per Amount

ProblemOut.description: application/problem+json shape, also embedded in failed runs.
ProblemOut.title: ProblemOut

QuickPickOut.description: A one-tap add: the ingredient with its usual package (or a typical amount) and where it lives.
QuickPickOut.title: QuickPickOut

servings.description: Portions the lines make as written
servings.title: Servings

post.description:
Sign in with the app password. Sets a long-lived HttpOnly session cookie; wrong passwords are rate
limited (429 with Retry-After).

get.description: 200 when the cookie is valid (and renewed if it's over a day old), else 401.

post.description:
Nutrition and per-store cost for a list of lines. With `scale_to_portions`, every line is first
scaled and rounded to a practical amount, and the numbers are computed from the rounded amounts.

get.description: A cook batch's recipe at its practical quantities, with the plan's package and freezing notes.

post.description:
Mark a batch cooked: its practical quantities come out of inventory (open packages first) and a package
it opens stays as an open-package lot. Cooking the same batch twice is a 409.

patch.description:
Check an item off (or back on), with what you actually bought and paid if you like. Send only what
changed; repeating the same request changes nothing, so the offline queue can replay it.

post.description:
Done shopping: checked items become inventory lots and their actual prices become per-store price
observations. A repeated call returns what the first one did (nothing is added twice).

schema.title: Response Search Ingredients Api V1 Ingredients Get

get.description: Names the LLM used that aren't in the ingredient table yet (from the llm_call log).

schema.title: Response List Suggested Api V1 Ingredients Suggested Get
Response List Inventory Api V1 Inventory Get

post.description: Add several lots at once (quick add, or a confirmed note). All or nothing; beef can't be added.

schema.title: Response Add Many Api V1 Inventory Bulk Post

post.description:
Read a note like "2 lb chicken thighs and half a cabbage" into a preview. Nothing is saved: confirm
the items with POST /inventory/bulk.

get.description: One-tap adds: the ingredients your recipes use, each with its usual package or a typical amount.

schema.title: Response Get Quick Picks Api V1 Inventory Quick Picks Get

get.description:
Your recent plans, newest first. `is_current` marks the one the app opens on: the active plan for
this week, else the latest active plan, else the latest draft.

schema.title: Response List Plans Api V1 Plans Get

post.description:
Plan a week inside this request. The response is a stream of JSON lines (`PlanStreamEvent`):
`started` with the run id, `progress` and `heartbeat` lines while it works, and one final `result` with
the plan summary or the problem. The run record is kept (`GET /generation-runs/{id}`).
Manual price entry. A store is required: deal detection and grocery lists work per store.

schema.title: Response List Products Api V1 Products Get

get.description:
A recipe version scaled to any number of portions: practical quantities, code-computed nutrition
and cost, and the food-safety lines the app injects.
The draft seed library with nutrition and cost per serving, or the reasons it's incomplete.

schema.title: Response List Seed Recipes Api V1 Recipes Seed Get

put.description: Your explicit decisions: exclude, dislike, like, or allow a held (possibly-beef) item after review.
